note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 6.2 ("If one of the Optional Parameters in the OPEN message is recognized, but is malformed, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to 0 (Unspecific)."). TestSessionRFC4271OptionalParameterErrors drives a live OpenSent Session over net.Pipe: positive tests five malformed Type 2 optional parameter cases (wrong capability length, truncated capability value, empty capability parameter, truncated parameter value, truncated parameter header) and asserts each yields exact NOTIFICATION [2, 0] with empty Data and StateIdle; negative tests valid Route Refresh capability ([2, 2, 2, 0]) and asserts KEEPALIVE and StateOpenConfirm.
